race.comment: ARTEMIS MISSION (4) turned in a good run last time out, finishing fourth in a higher-graded race at this circuit and distance. Draws a little wider but this looks easier and he should be hitting peak fitness now. Good enough to take out a race like this. FLOPPA (8) drew on the second row and settled back last start but worked home in good style to finish a head from the winner in second at Shepparton, making it back-to-back placings. Tactics will be crucial from this wide draw but he looks close to a win. WHATTA YA UP TAA (3) galloped out last start but placed here prior so is worth another chance. YANKEE BABE (5) continued her consistent form when fourth here last time out and draws lower.
